title-villa.note: The title screen's street (UI track): a two-storey villa with an orange roof and a porch, its cast shadow included, standing on the lawn left of the Open House sign. Modern Exteriors, the pack whose license allows open-source projects.

title-villa-blue.note: The same villa with a blue roof, the title street's neighbor on the right of the sign.

title-tree.note: A round garden tree on its grass patch, for the title street's back lawn between the houses.

title-oak.note: A broad oak, for the title street's back lawn.

title-car.note: A blue hatchback seen from the side, facing right: it drives along the title street (parked when Reduce motion is on).

title-shrub.note: A small tree for the title street's front lawn, between the sign and the houses.
